mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply chain, leading to lower corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month, the combination signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between UNRATE and PAYEMS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong demand in the housing market, boosting related industries and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between INDPRO and GDPC1 on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
